spec_features.spec_quote: a `[[GIVE_UP]]` sentinel the model may (but need not) emit
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:26 defines GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='[[GIVE_UP]]'; SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:34-35) tells the subject it may emit the sentinel to stop early; harness.py:403 `gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in (resp.text or '')`, line 405-407 sets stop_reason='give_up', and line 428-429 `if gave_up or any_green: break` actually breaks the rollout loop. Real instruction delivered to subject AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: instruction in system prompt, detected, and breaks the agent loop. The 'stop early' wording is neutral/optional.

spec_features.spec_quote: A rollout stops at the category turn budget
spec_features.evidence: config.py:26-32 DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS per category; run.py:82 turn_budget = cfg.turn_budgets.get(category, ...); passed to run_rollout_async (run.py:91); harness.py:347 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)` bounds the loop and harness.py:431 sets stop_reason='turn_budget' when exhausted. The loop is genuinely capped by the budget.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a hard upper bound on turns via range(turn_budget).
